newsitem.title: INDONESIA: President Suharto names 200 millionth Indonesian.
newsitem.headline: President Suharto names 200 millionth Indonesian.

text.p: Indonesian President Suharto on Wednesday named a baby born on the island of Lombok as the country's 200 millionth citizen, a government minister said.
Population Minister Haryono Suyono told reporters that the president gave the baby boy, born on Tuesday in the East Lombok village of Jero Waru, the name Wahyu Nusantara Aji.
In Indonesian, Wahyu means a divine revelation, Nusantara is another word for Indonesia and Aji is something very valuable.
Lombok lies near the resort island of Bali, east of the capital Jakarta.
Suyono said Indonesia's population increased by 8,778 on average every day, bringing the figure on Wednesday to an estimated 200,008,778.
Suharto gave the child, one of 81 selected from Indonesia's 27 provinces, unlimited scholarships for his education.
The Jakarta Post newspaper said on Wednesday that to qualify, the baby had to meet the criteria of being either the first or second-born child of a literate and legally married couple.
Its mother should have been at least 20 years old at the time of marriage and a participant of the government-sponsored family planning programme which advocates two children per family.
